comment.body: Thanks for the detailed network checks and follow-up reports. The supplied `Rejected Settings IPC client: untrusted-signature` entry matches #50795, where valid but different executable signers block Settings-sync communication. Please consolidate that confirmed failure there. The latest report that 0.101 works while restarting and clearing local state do not is useful regression evidence, but the identical pairing message alone does not establish this cause on every PC. For reports without a confirmed signer rejection, please check the failure-time MWB diagnostic log for that exact rejection and share the relevant result so we can distinguish the existing signer issue from another pairing failure. Service removal is not a verified general fix, and no signature-verification bypass is recommended.
